svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V1 · The Plank — Extras
svg.desc: A storm cloud to put on the board when the forecast says storm (the bolt is engraved inside the cut cloud). A ship's wheel for whoever sails first. A rules card with the numbers the app keeps for you. Units: mm. 20 mm squares, 3 mm material. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
